name: invariant-load-isolation
description: Synthetic 6219-row project with slow DB-only invariant hydration concurrent with display polls and a close through the authenticated API write door. The close must settle within the bounded refresh time, advance version and generated_at, reconcile the closed step, preserve unauthorized-write refusal and avoid duplicate hydrations. Runs in internal/api:TestInvariantLoadIsolationScenario; actual 20-id batching, cancellation, progress reuse and fresh-action bypass run in internal/beads:TestIsolatedIncrementalRetainsProgressWithoutBlockingDisplay.
